description: Capture the visible screen and run approved desktop actions on macOS or Windows for any app. Use context/apps/windows, show_app to bring Vivaldi/Chrome/etc. to the main screen, and select_window before screenshots or actions. Hidden-window/background control is disabled.

config.name: computer_use
config.summary: 全アプリ向けの可視画面コンピューター操作。まず action=context/apps/windows で開いているアプリとウィンドウを確認し、必要なら show_app で Vivaldi/Chrome/VS Code/Finder/LINE などをメイン画面に表示します。文字入力は action=type と text を優先してください。隠れたウィンドウやDOMバックグラウンド操作は使いません。

action.description: Use context/apps/windows to inspect open apps, show_app with app/name to bring an app to the main visible screen, select_window with app/title to target a visible window, and screenshot before actions. For image clicks, prefer point:[y,x] with coordinate_space=normalized_1000, where y and x are 0-1000 coordinates from the latest screenshot. click operates the visible UI and returns a marked post-action screenshot; type/key/scroll also return a post-action screenshot unless include_screenshot=false. Set physical=false or virtual_only=true when you only want a marker preview.

point.description: Preferred image-click coordinate as [y, x] normalized from 0 to 1000 on the latest screenshot, matching browser_tool_test.

point_order.description: Use yx for point:[y,x] (default) or xy for point:[x,y].

normalized_point.description: Alias for point:[y,x] in normalized 0-1000 coordinates.

from_x.description: Alias for drag start x coordinate.

from_y.description: Alias for drag start y coordinate.

to_x.description: Alias for drag end x coordinate.

to_y.description: Alias for drag end y coordinate.

text.description: Text to enter when action is type. Prefer this over repeated key presses for words.

key.description: Single key or shortcut key for action=key, for example backspace, return, or a with modifier=meta.

modifier.description: Optional single key modifier such as meta, command, control, shift, or alt.

scope.description: For action=apps: running, installed, or all.

coordinate_space.description: screen for absolute display pixels, window/screenshot for selected-window pixels, model_image for returned model preview pixels, or normalized_1000 for browser_tool_test-style [y,x] 0-1000 coordinates.

virtual_only.description: For click/drag, preview the marker and AI cursor without operating the real UI.

open.description: For select_app: launch an installed app if it is not already running.

driver.description: Optional driver hint such as foreground_input or physical.

settings_fields.label: Default Target
settings_fields.help: Default desktop target for new tasks; request-specific details are supplied at call time.

settings_fields.label: Default Mode
settings_fields.help: Preferred operating mode before issuing desktop actions.

settings_fields.label: Safety Default
settings_fields.help: Durable safety preference for desktop operations.

settings_fields.label: Screenshot Quality
settings_fields.help: Default screenshot/detail preference for visual inspection.
